summary: Held the entire episode. Price moved favorable almost immediately (0 -> +24 -> +53 -> peak +57 by t=5-6m) and never approached breakeven or went negative after the first minute; the rest of the window was profit-taking chop between roughly +28 and +56, always well in favor with giveback staying under ~40% of the leg amplitude. No sustained against-fires or negative-price signature ever appeared to suggest the entry was wrong-direction, so there was never a bail trigger. Next time: watch for the leg to actually cross back toward 0 or amp giveback to blow past ~50% with against-fires stacking, since here it was just a strong winner consolidating, not a reversal.
